title: GeoFlag
description:
A world worth wandering.

Об игре

A geography game for quiet curiosity. 

• All 193 UN member countries, with more places and US States to discover.

• Explore at your own pace or put your knowledge to the test.

• A cozy, living world for curious minds, armchair travelers, and families sharing a little time together.

FROM ORBIT TO THE MAP.Every Map Game round begins on the globe, then the camera dives down onto a real, photoreal Earth where you place flags onto the right countries. Regional levels build toward the whole world, with US States as a bonus and a Hardcore mode that adds the micro-states most people miss. Earn coins as you improve.

STUDY A LIVING GLOBE.Rotate the Study Globe, explore a region, and open country cards covering flags, capitals, languages, currencies and natural wonders. Choose satellite imagery or the classic map, browse freely or follow a guided tour. Your animated explorer accompanies you, with no timer or scoring.

ONE MORE RUN.Endless Expedition challenges you to identify flags for as long as you can. Start with three lanterns and lose one with each wrong answer. As you advance, the flags become more challenging. See how far you can get, then return to improve your best.

CHAIN THE BORDERS.Find a path between countries using their shared land borders. Border Run gives you five routes per session, with hints available when you need them. The results globe traces your journeys and lets you compare your choices with a shortest route. 
 

WORLD QUIZ.Test your knowledge of capitals, country shapes and land borders. World Quiz combines discovery and practice with trials that help you build mastery and unlock further expeditions.

A NEW EXPEDITION EVERY DAY.Ten countries, one fresh puzzle, the same challenge for every player worldwide. Build your streak, beat your time, come back tomorrow. Chain correct answers and your combo builds across every mode. 

MORE WAYS TO PLAY WITH FLAGS. Geo Cards turns flags into quick, lighter sessions. Match flag pairs from memory, perfect for shorter breaks. 

 CLIMB THE LEADERBOARD.Your lifetime XP counts as Knowledge Points on the Steam leaderboard, including previously earned progress. Compare your total with friends and other players. Joining is optional, local profile names remain private, and your highest profile total counts if you have several profiles.

A HOME OF YOUR OWN. Collect 25 achievements as colorful magnets in your cozy room. Locked magnets show what you can work toward next, while your explorer points out nearby goals. Each achievement also unlocks on your Steam profile.

BUILT FOR CRAFT, NOT GRIND• All 193 UN member countries, with more study content on the way

• Stars, achievements, and explorer tiers

• 25 achievements, a home that fills in as you earn them, and real Steam achievement support

• A combo system that rewards getting into a rhythm

• An optional Steam leaderboard with lifetime Knowledge Points

• Saved progress between sessions and Steam Cloud support on Windows

• Single-player, no ads, no microtransactions
 
 
The world is bigger than you think. GeoFlag is here to help you see more of it. 
 

Built with care by a solo developer. Tested daily by his two daughters. Made for the curious, the wandering, and anyone who still gets a small thrill from finding a country they didn't know existed.
description_short: GeoFlag is a relaxing geography quiz game where you explore a 3D globe, learn world flags, identify countries and capitals, solve border challenges, and compete in daily quizzes. Discover the world at your own pace or test your knowledge.
